name: List jobs
description: Lists the jobs of the user you act for, oldest first: what ran, who started it, when, and how it ended, without inputs or results. Without a start, the latest jobs; with one, the first created from then on. To read on, start again from the last job's created time. status and caller narrow it. Read-only operations, such as reading data, leave no job, so they never appear here. Needs crud/read on the user's jobs (j).

start.description: List the first jobs created at or after this time: ISO-8601, such as 2026-11-21T09:00:00Z, or epoch milliseconds. Without it, the latest jobs.

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 50 by default.

status.description: Only jobs with this status, or one of these: PENDING, STARTED, PAUSED, INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED, COMPLETE, FAILED, TIMEOUT, REJECTED, CANCELLED.

caller.description: Only jobs this principal started, a DID; jobs of principals under it, such as its agents, count too.

jobs.description: Oldest first, each with id, created, updated, name, operation, status, caller, and where they apply agent, session, parent (the job it ran inside), error (shortened) and tokens (model tokens used).
